name: gauntlet-loop
description: Push a goal past a real-world bar with per-piece builder and blind-critic loops.

interface.shortDescription: Loop every piece until it beats a real reference blind.
interface.longDescription: Matt Shumer's Gauntlet Loop: set a concrete bar, split the goal, and run each piece through a builder and a fresh, harsh, blind critic until ours wins or you stop it.
interface.defaultPrompt: Build the supplied goal and keep improving each piece until it beats the bar in a blind comparison.
